ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels across approximately 75% of the visible surface with low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the center and periphery; estimated ratio 3:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions on both lateral lobes; a central low-intensity black band extends vertically from the peduncle towards the notch; high-contrast black borders of varying pixel-width align the trailing edge with scattered mottling at the base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated aperture of approximately 42 degrees relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular boundary topography; high-frequency micro-serrations (1-3 pixel depth) along the inner edges transitioning to high-amplitude, low-frequency jagged protrusions (5-15 pixel depth) at the distal sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the primary trailing edge, terminating in upward-sweeping, sharp geometric points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of dark and brownish high-contrast pixel groups localized at the extreme left and right distal tips; scattered circular black spots on the medial right white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions observed on the mid-section white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent biological masses (likely barnacle colonization) at both fluke tips; significant asymmetrical jagged voids along the trailing edge contour indicating historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique brownish-red pixel coloration localized to the distal tips, distinct from the standard black and white pigmentation mapping.
